purpose: Compose CoMind authoritative systems into one governed personal cognitive control plane without creating a competing source of truth.
governing_invariant: CoMind Home may organize attention and route governed actions, but observable state must remain traceable to the authoritative owner system and must never exceed verified implementation reality.

domains.label: Now
domains.projection_policy: Rank bounded attention candidates without persisting a second attention ledger. Preserve each source identity, source state, authority state, and freshness.
domains.coverage_limit: Only registered attention sources participate. Absence from Now does not prove absence from the source system.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unavailable source remains visibly unavailable and cannot be converted to zero attention items.
domains.write_authority: none_direct; actions route to the owning source system

domains.label: Projects
domains.projection_policy: Use cm_project for project identity and hierarchy. Use pm_projects only for operational RunBook state linked through canonical_project_id.
domains.coverage_limit: Operational PM rows may be absent for canonical projects that have no active RunBook projection.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Do not fabricate operational status for a canonical project with no PM projection.
domains.write_authority: project mutations route to canonical project owner; operational work mutations route to PM and RunBook owner

domains.label: Virtual Employees
domains.projection_policy: Render identity, lifecycle, authority ceiling, grants, activity, and resource references from Foundry and VE owner systems. No Home-local VE roster.
domains.coverage_limit: A profile is not proof of current authorization for a consequential action.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unknown lifecycle or authority fails closed and is shown as unknown.
domains.write_authority: VE lifecycle and capability changes route through governed VE and Foundry commands

domains.label: Decisions
domains.projection_policy: Present operational decisions and structured decision analyses with distinct provenance. Do not reinterpret authorization decisions as product or architecture decisions.
domains.coverage_limit: Not every discussion or recommendation is a decision record.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Missing decision evidence is not represented as approval or rejection.
domains.write_authority: decision recording routes to the owning decision system

domains.label: Approvals
domains.projection_policy: Keep requested, authorized, expired, executed, and verified states separate. A visible request never implies approval or execution.
domains.coverage_limit: Home shows approval state but does not grant authority.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unknown or unavailable authority is not authorized.
domains.write_authority: approval decisions route through the governed approval or authorization owner

domains.label: Evidence
domains.projection_policy: Index evidence identity and provenance while preserving native source references. Home may summarize but not replace source artifacts.
domains.coverage_limit: Evidence presence proves only what the evidence contract supports.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unavailable evidence remains unavailable and cannot be replaced by narrative confidence.
domains.write_authority: evidence creation routes through existing evidence capture paths

domains.label: RunBook
domains.projection_policy: Reuse Durable RunBook views for chronology, lane state, authority, verification, and next action. Home does not copy RunBook events.
domains.coverage_limit: RunBook may lag external systems until reconciled.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unavailable RunBook state is unknown, not completed.
domains.write_authority: RunBook writes use canonical append paths only

domains.label: Research
domains.projection_policy: Project RLIB metadata, authority, version, freshness, supersession, provenance, and artifact links. Do not copy document bodies into a Home store.
domains.coverage_limit: RLIB intake state is not canonical research until accepted by the RLIB owner workflow.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unverified or inaccessible source remains visibly unverified or unavailable.
domains.write_authority: research intake and classification route to RLIB owner workflows

domains.label: Learning
domains.projection_policy: Render ordered learning paths as references to governed Research Library records. Never duplicate research content into learning copies.
domains.coverage_limit: Learning path membership does not upgrade research authority or freshness.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unavailable referenced research is shown as unavailable in the path.
domains.write_authority: learning-path composition routes to the Learning and RLIB owner contract

domains.label: Watchtower

authoritative_sources.ref: GitHub Actions and Lane Health Sentinel

domains.projection_policy: Federate registered alert and monitoring sources into one attention surface. Preserve source identity and source lifecycle. Do not create a universal Watchtower event ledger.
domains.coverage_limit: Watchtower covers only registered monitor adapters. It is not proof that every subsystem is healthy.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Unavailable monitor is degraded visibility, never healthy.
domains.write_authority: acknowledgement or remediation routes to the source monitor owner; Watchtower has no implicit remediation authority

domains.label: Reflection
domains.projection_policy: Render authored journal and reflection entries from cm_journal_entry. CE continuity may provide context links, never silently become journal content or personal truth.
domains.coverage_limit: No inference, trait, memory, or CE signal is promoted to Reflection without an explicit journal write through the owner path.
domains.unavailable_semantics: No journal entry means no recorded reflection, not a negative inference.
domains.write_authority: reflection writes route to the canonical journal owner with explicit authorship

domains.label: Implementation Integrity
domains.projection_policy: Combine canonical registry definitions and maturity with exact execution evidence. Never infer ENFORCED or GOVERNED from a passing unrelated workflow.
domains.coverage_limit: Repository controls do not by themselves establish Production runtime conformity.
domains.unavailable_semantics: Missing exact-head evidence is unverified, not passing.
domains.write_authority: integrity maturity changes remain owned by Implementation Integrity lanes
